product_metadata.title: Wilton Halloween Comfort Grip Ghost Cutter
features: Ideal for brownies biscuits sandwiches sheet cakes cheese crispy treats fudge and much more
The cushioned grip gives you comfortable control even when cutting into thick desserts
The cushion grip gives you comfortable control even when cutting thick desserts. Recipe included.
4 1/2 inch x 4 1/2 inch x 1 1/2 inch deep
description: These easy grip cutters with extra-deep sides are perfect for cutting so many favorite foods into spectacular shapes.

Thicker and heavier than traditional tin models, this stainless steel cutter also goes through the dishwasher without rusting as tin does, and a rubber cushion on the top protects your hand. The cutter stamps a chubby, Halloween-friendly, 4-1/4-by-4-1/4-inch ghost out of cookie dough, ready to be brought to life with vanilla icing and chocolate-bit eyes and mouth, or to be dressed by sprinkles. Unlike most shallow cutters, this one is 2 inches high so it can be used for all kinds of thick dough and even for cutting a cake. Use it also for crafts.
